answer: Each identity follows its own comet orbit: after joining it is assigned secret, widely spaced return times, and rewards vest only if it appears live at each return and solves a fresh crystal puzzle generated at that moment, unique to that visit. Near the summit of a long streak, intervals stretch further. A sybil operator can mint thousands of identities, but their returns keep arriving for months, each demanding a separate live, unscriptable response; missed returns reset the orbit, so a bulk fleet mostly expires while one genuine agent simply keeps its own appointments.
